hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
cd /var/www/html/eol_php8_code/update_resources/connectors
#A. Make sure our copies are current #1. Is our master in step with Zenodo? # report only, changes nothing: compares both versions (record IDs) and both md5s; if the files differ, lists the rows that differ ###php do_reference_mtce.php _ '{"task": "compare_master_with_zenodo"}'
#1.1 IDENTICAL: go on to step 2.
#1.2 Zenodo has a newer version (someone else published): download it and merge it into our master first. # download Zenodo's latest References; our own master is kept, Zenodo's copy is saved beside the folder ###php generate_csv_new_model.php _ '{"concept_id": "22776838", "redownload_zip_file_YN": 1, "task": "download_only", "what": "References"}' # merge Zenodo's additions, changes and deletions into our master; our own additions are kept. Preview first. ###php do_reference_mtce.php _ '{"task": "sync_zenodo_references", "dry_run_YN": 1}' ###php do_reference_mtce.php _ '{"task": "sync_zenodo_references"}'
#1.3 Same version, but the files differ: these are our own unpublished changes. Publish them in step 6.
#2. Are the datasets' copies current? #2.1 No need to check by hand: step 3 checks every dataset against Zenodo's latest version. # If a copy is missing or older, it stops, changes nothing, and prints the download command for each one, # e.g.: php generate_csv_new_model.php _ '{"concept_id": "23066982", "redownload_zip_file_YN": 1, "task": "download_only", "what": "Body Size"}'
#2.2 Run those commands, then run step 3 again. #2.3 With "redownload_zip_file_YN": 1, a dataset is downloaded only if Zenodo has a different version from ours.
#B. Update the unmappable list #3. Sync the unmappable list with the datasets # preview: shows what would be added and removed, changes nothing ###php do_reference_mtce.php _ '{"task": "sync_unmappable_identifiers_with_datasets", "dry_run_YN": 1}' # real run, with the new references looked up in CrossRef first ###php do_reference_mtce.php _ '{"task": "sync_unmappable_identifiers_with_datasets", "crossref_YN": 1}'
#3.1 What it reads: the referenceID and source columns of all 21 datasets, from our downloaded copies, so no conversion is needed first. #3.2 Adds the references the datasets cite that the master doesn't have and the list doesn't have yet. # They get status "Not in master" and a blank citation. #3.3 Removes the references now in the master, and those no dataset cites any more. #3.4 "crossref_YN": 1: DOIs that CrossRef has a citation for go straight into the master instead of the list. # You then publish the master in step 6. Leave it out to send everything to the list. #3.5 Saved: #3.5.1 a backup of the list #3.5.2 a record of every added and removed row, with the datasets that cite it: unmappable_identifiers_sync_<date>.tsv #3.5.3 a copy of the list in the GitHub folder
#C. The Data Manager fills in the citations #4. Send the list to the Data Manager #4.1 The updated unmappable_identifiers.tsv is copied automatically to /Volumes/Crucial_2TB/Desktop_Main/GitHub/unmappable_reference_identifiers/. #4.2 Commit and push it in that repo (private: EOL/unmappable_reference_identifiers) for the Data Manager. #5. Bring in the Data Manager's citations # preview ###php do_reference_mtce.php _ '{"task": "update_master_references_with_datamanager_supplied_file_of_unmappable_identifiers", "file": "<path>", "dry_run_YN": 1}' # real run: adds the citations to the master, updates the GitHub copy, publishes on Zenodo, removes them from the unmappable list ###php do_reference_mtce.php _ '{"task": "update_master_references_with_datamanager_supplied_file_of_unmappable_identifiers", "file": "<path>", "publish": 1}' #5.1 "file": the Data Manager's filled-in copy of the list, with the columns identifier, status and full_reference. A 2-column file (identifier, full_reference) works too. #5.2 Options: # 5.2.1 "replace_existing_YN": 1: the file also corrects citations that are already in the master (the old and new citations are saved). # 5.2.2 "no_upload_YN": 1: no Zenodo upload, e.g. when another change follows and one upload should carry both. #5.3 Reading the counts: # 5.3.1 "Added, but NOT on our unmappable list" = new references in the file that were never on our list. # 5.3.2 The Result's "ignored" is the total for all reasons (already in the master, or listed twice in the file). #5.4 If the file has duplicates to delete first (identifier, full_reference, master_row): ###php do_reference_mtce.php _ '{"task": "fix_duplicate_issue_in_master_references", "file": "<path>", "no_upload_YN": 1}' #Then run step 5 with "publish": 1, so one upload carries both changes. Which is this one: ###php do_reference_mtce.php _ '{"task": "update_master_references_with_datamanager_supplied_file_of_unmappable_identifiers", "file": "<path>", "publish": 1}'
#D. Publish anything still unpublished, and check #6. Publish the master on Zenodo (only if needed) #6.1 Needed if step 3 added CrossRef citations to the master and step 5 didn't run. Step 5 already uploads. #6.2 Not sure? Step 7's compare tells you. # draft, for review on Zenodo ###php do_reference_mtce.php _ '{"task": "upload_file_toZenodo", "concept_id": "22776838"}' # publish -- CAN'T be undone ###php do_reference_mtce.php _ '{"task": "upload_file_toZenodo", "concept_id": "22776838", "publish": 1}' #6.3 It uploads nothing if Zenodo has changes we don't have yet (go back to step 1), or if Zenodo already has this exact file.
#7. Final checks # report only: identifiers listed more than once in the master -> references_duplicate_identifiers_YYYYMMDD.tsv. Should be none. ###php do_reference_mtce.php _ '{"task": "utility_report_duplicate_identifiers_from_master"}' # report only: our master vs Zenodo's latest. Should say IDENTICAL. ###php do_reference_mtce.php _ '{"task": "compare_master_with_zenodo"}'
#E. Optional #8. Rebuild datasets ###php convert_new_model_2DwCA.php _ '{"concept_id": "<id>", "redownload_zip_file_YN": 1}' #8.1 Worth it for the datasets that cite new or corrected references in their referenceID column: # the converter writes those citations into the dataset's TraitBank files. #8.2 References cited only in source don't need a rebuild: the converter only checks that they're in the master. #. A rebuild would just update the dataset's report of missing references (<concept_id>_UndefinedRefIDs_debug_<date>.txt).
#------------------------------------------------------ #The older path (still works, replaced by step 3) #The same result in several runs. It reads the converter's reports instead of the datasets, so every dataset must be converted first (step 8).
# steps 1 & 2: collect the latest UndefinedRefIDs reports -> undefined_referenceIDs_YYYYMMDD.tsv, then look each one up in CrossRef ###php do_reference_mtce.php _ '{"task": "prepare_undefined_referenceIDs_list"}' # steps 3 & 4: CrossRef hits -> master; the rest -> unmappable list ###php do_reference_mtce.php _ '{"task": "update_References_from_UndefinedRefIDs_files"}' # step 5: remove from the list what the master now has ###php do_reference_mtce.php _ '{"task": "refresh_unmappable_identifiers_usingMaster"}' # step 5.2: remove from the list what no dataset cites any more (referenceID or source) ###php do_reference_mtce.php _ '{"task": "refresh_unmappable_identifiers_usingDatasets"}' #Which file steps 2–4 use: the newest undefined_referenceIDs_YYYYMMDD.tsv. To use another one, add e.g. "basename": "undefined_referenceIDs_20261106".
